english_translations.sahih_international: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
english_translations.pickthall: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
english_translations.shakir: The day on which no soul shall control anything for (another) soul; and the command on that day shall be entirely Allah's.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, no soul will be of any benefit to any other soul. On that day, all affairs will be in the hands of God.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: (It will be) the Day when no person shall have power (to do) anything for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
english_translations.arberry: A day when no soul shall possess aught to succour another soul; that day the Command shall belong unto God.
